text:
mira: Quick sync on invoke adapter roadmap. Product wants a minimal, auditable v1 by end of Q2.
jamal: Engineering prefers a two-step rollout: v1 = sync JSON envelope + schema validation; v2 = async webhooks + streaming chunks. Lower blast radius.
kevin: Security: require response signature when tool runs outside the platform trust domain. Webhooks need enterprise auth flows.
elaine: Support asks: clear error taxonomy and trace_id on every call so we can debug user-facing failures fast.
ci-bot: canary policy: 14-day canary after deploy; contract tests must pass.
mira: Proposed v1 envelope (compact):
```json
{"envelope_version":"1","call_id":"1991000000","tool":"extract","input":{},"result":{"status":"ok|error","output":null,"error_code":null},"telemetry":{"trace_id":"t-abc","tokens":12}}
```
jamal: Lock decisions for v1: JSON Schema tool manifests, closed status enums, envelope_version top-level, and machine error codes.
kevin: Also include content_type for non-JSON results and a signature field. Max payload size must be documented.
elaine: For v1 we can skip callbacks; customers who need async can use polling or a v1.1 webhook opt-in.
mira: Roadmap: Q2 GA v1 (sync + manifests + docs), Q3 v1.1 webhooks (opt-in for enterprise), Q4 v2 streaming.
jamal: Launch checklist (eng): public schema + examples, server-side validation, contract suite green, 2 partner canaries, SDK snippets.
kevin: Compliance: webhooks require legal signoff; private deployments may use a pull adapter.
ci-bot: staging tests: contract fail 1/12 (enum mismatch).
jamal: I'll fix enum drift tonight.
mira: Action items: jamal -> PR schema by Thu; kevin -> draft signature/webhook security guide; elaine -> support-runbook + error mappings.
kevin: Decision: envelope_version field so old logs can be interpreted; avoid Accept-header versioning for now.
mira: Reconvene Friday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
